title: Zesty Velvety Korean Pork Bao
description: A pungent and cozy American dish featuring ssamjang and brine-dry pork, perfect for a diabetic-friendly meal. This recipe combines the flavors of Korea with a velvety texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine ssamjang, gochujang, soy sauce, and brown sugar to make the sauce.
Place the brine-dry pork shoulder in a large baking dish and brush the sauce all over it.
Bake the pork for 6 hours or until it is tender and easily shreds with a fork.
While the pork is baking, prepare the bao buns according to the package instructions.
Once the pork is done, shred it with two forks and stir in chopped green onions and minced garlic.
Assemble the bao by spooning the pork mixture onto the bun.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F, then rest 3 minutes before serving.
